blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Asia Business Law Journal (ABLJ) on Monday, Oct. 19, released its “A-List” of the Philippines’ top 100 lawyers and legal icons, recognizing their “exceptional service standards and commitment to industry best practices.” The ABLJ said its list was based on extensive research involving thousands of in-house counsel in the Philippines and around the world, as well as partners at international law firms, who identified lawyers they believed had distinguished themselves. A-List lawyers are defined on the nomination form as “lawyers who are currently the star performers of the Philippines’ legal profession; the lawyers who are personally undertaking […]...
